TICKET 9579a6f9cec6 (chart chain complete through `validate`; `verdict` still null). AKIEN'S RED, and it is the whole session: "i can't imagine why we should need to parse all class space every 60 seconds. that's not efficient." He named cairn/tools/base/probes/hand_spelled_instance_paths.py. MEASURED: he was right and the cause was wider than the probe he named. The ground-loop beat cost 104.8s (NOT the ">9 minutes" an earlier writing of bus_client.reach()'s docstring claimed — that claim is falsified and the correction now stands beside it in the same docstring). The probe he named is 1.17s over 457 files, 2% of the beat.

THREE ROOT CAUSES, all landed, all committed in cairn (42c9e15, 11d2ec0, e53a973):
(1) chain.claiming_packets re-globbed and re-parsed all 2,552 chart berths per call; chain_for_ticket calls it 8x; one probe called that 196x per beat = 1,568 full store sweeps = 55.6s. Fixed by a packet INDEX keyed on the packets/ dir mtime (berths are write-once, so the dir mtime is a sound token). Bodies are still re-read from disk, never served from the index. Proof cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_packet_index.py, 7 teeth, mutation-verified.
(2) NOTHING EVER POPULATED THE PULSE CONTEXT. 60 of 68 probe files re-derived their whole survey, and three times over when firing (fires -> payload -> gathered_enough). Fixed by `once(context, key, compute)` in cairn/tools/base/probe.py, wired at 94 call sites across 41 probe files + 6 nested judges. THE PROOF CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT: the first wiring produced ZERO improvement because Probe's three predicate methods each spelled `context or {}`, and `{}` is falsy — an empty-but-real context was silently replaced by a NEW dict per predicate, so the memo could never be shared. Fixed with `_pulse(context)` (isinstance check). This is Law 6 at the primitive: a peer must not substitute the context it was handed. Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe_once.py, 7 teeth.
(3) Corpus scans re-derived on a clock against a world that changes on a commit. Fixed by cairn/tools/base/settled.py — settled(key, root, compute), an answer kept until a stat sweep of the tree says it moved. Wired at the two scans, not their sixteen callers: orient.device_census (cold 705ms -> warm 5.0ms) and address_rule.scan (cold 1133ms -> warm 5.0ms). Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_settled.py, 9 teeth, 7 mutations each caught by the tooth aimed at it.

BEAT, MEASURED: 104.8s -> 45.7s after (1)+(2). trigger 57.5->42.8, carry 24.0->2.1, enough 22.6->0.1. The post-`settled` re-measure was STILL RUNNING at this boundary and is NOT yet a number — do not quote one.

ALSO FIXED EN ROUTE: probes/unchartered_build_edits.py had been DEAD SINCE 2026-08-28 — it called os.path.isfile() on a chart_claim that is prose in 183 of 196 PROVED tickets and a dict in 12 (TypeError), and the shim's per-probe isolation swallowed it so the watch read healthy. The chart_claim gate is deleted; chain_for_ticket is the authoritative reader. That probe went 55.6s -> 1.4s.
